name: Daybreak rank 6 chains with its lower ranks, not as an unrelated spell (#9159, already fixed by #9420)
contract: #9159 reported Daybreak missing a rank the player already owned a prerequisite for. #9420 (merged, Refs #9159) found rev_20260903_01_live_class_baseline's spell_ranks chain for Daybreak 500147 stopped at rank 5 (503624), one short of SpellRank.dbc/the trainer, and added rev_20261026_06_coa_sun_cleric_rank_chains.sql: (500147, 572035, 6). Before that row existed, SpellMgr::GetFirstSpellInChain(572035) resolved to 572035 itself, not 500147, so every Named(info,500147)/Highest(player,500147) call in this module's C++ (which key purely on chain membership, never a literal spell id list) silently stopped recognizing the top rank. Hot Spot 301256's own tooltip is 'Casting Daybreak now causes your next 2 Shines...to have a reduced cast time', implemented at AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:197-198 as `if (Named(info,500147) && player->HasAura(301256)) Cast(player,player,301242)`. This scenario casts rank 6 (572035) directly, independent of the natural level-up grant path (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h still only lists ranks up to 503624; rank 6 is trainer-sold per #9420's PR body) and asserts the Hot Spot buff 301242 is applied, which only happens when 572035 is recognized as a Daybreak rank; before the fix this cast would not have triggered it.
